description: a ring torus, R 3 and r 1 about z, in common with a block at a general pose, five of whose planes cut the tube: closed toric sections cut into blocks by the block's edges, and a block of a closed curve may wrap past the end of its periodic knots. On a plane that matters: a plane's pcurve of a fitted section is exact — the same periodic NURBS in the plane's coordinates — so the wrapped block is a range past the knots' end, and its quadrature and its polygon are split at the domain's knots a period on (`NurbsCurve2::breaks_within`). Taken in one Gauss interval across its spans, as it was, this result measured 8e-4 off in volume with every row of the checker green, a random pose in three hundred. The tolerances are stated at 1e-6 because the oracle's own solid is the far side here: Open CASCADE leaves a section edge of it at a tolerance of 2.4e-5, and its volume 12.98893543 is 1.2e-7 from the 12.9889338178 Arris converges to as the model tolerance goes from 1e-7 to 1e-9 — and which Open CASCADE itself measures, to 3e-12, on the STEP Arris writes
